bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; a=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state IN ('publishing','needs_reconcile') AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND message_id>0") || exit 61; b=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state IN ('publishing','needs_reconcile') AND message_id IS NULL") || exit 62; c=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state='verified' AND message_id IS NULL") || exit 63; test "$a" -le 5 && test "$b" -le 5 && test "$c" -le 5 || exit 64; exit $((100+a+10*b+20*c))
